widgets_values:
subject_definitions:
<Video 1> is the source video for the target video edit: a continuous 10.83-second shot of two dancers performing side by side on a large circular patterned floor, with a static wide camera and a dark, dimly lit venue behind them.
<Subject 1> is the man on the left in <Video 1>; his face, hairstyle, skin tone, body build and clothing come from <Picture 1>.
<Subject 2> is the man on the right in <Video 1>; his face, hairstyle, skin tone, body build and clothing come from <Picture 2>.
<Audio 1> is the synchronized audio track of <Video 1>, reused as the target video's complete final soundtrack.

summary:
[video editing + reference generation + audio reuse] The target video is an edited version of <Video 1> in which <Subject 1> and <Subject 2> replace the two original performers while every pose, step, contact point, camera position, background, lighting, framing and timing of <Video 1> stays unchanged.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): attribute_transfer - face, hair, skin tone, body build and clothing are replaced by those in <Picture 1>; silhouette, pose, limb positions and screen position are retained from <Video 1>.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1]): attribute_transfer - face, hair, skin tone, body build and clothing are replaced by those in <Picture 2>; silhouette, pose, limb positions and screen position are retained from <Video 1>.
<Video 1> (single continuous shot): fully_preserved - one uncut static wide shot; choreography, timing, camera height, framing, background and lighting are copied 1:1.
<Audio 1>: fully_copy - the synchronized track is reused 1:1 as the complete final audio.

detailed_description:
The target video is a live-action, cinematic single take with the same aspect ratio, color palette and lighting as <Video 1>.
[Shot 1] A static wide shot at the original camera height and distance holds both dancers head-to-toe in frame from the first frame to the last. <Subject 1>, the man whose appearance comes from <Picture 1>, stands on the left, and <Subject 2>, the man whose appearance comes from <Picture 2>, stands on the right, at the same positions, spacing and floor marks they occupy in <Video 1>, with the circular patterned floor beneath them and the dark venue with its low warm practical lights behind. Both dancers reproduce the choreography exactly, with the same limb angles, foot placement, weight shifts, turns and timing at every beat. The camera never moves, zooms, pans, tilts or cuts, and the framing never changes to a close-up or medium close-up: both dancers stay fully visible at the original scale for the entire shot. The background, floor pattern, light direction and color temperature remain identical, and no new objects, performers, captions or on-screen text appear. Throughout the shot the two dancers keep carrying the choreography of <Video 1> forward without pausing, stopping, holding a pose or adding a finish, and the closing frame of the shot matches the final frame of <Video 1> exactly in limb placement, spacing and facing direction. <Audio 1> runs unchanged from the first frame to the last.

overall_soundscape:
The complete audio track of <Audio 1> is reused unchanged from the first frame to the last frame.
